content: ACE-Step 1.5 VRAM figures verified from acestep/gpu_config.py source: DiT turbo/base weights 4.7 GB bf16, DiT XL (4B) 9.0 GB, VAE 0.33 GB, text encoder 1.2 GB, CUDA context 0.5 GB; LM models 0.6B=1.2GB / 1.7B=3.4GB / 4B=8.0GB weights. GPU tier system: <=4GB requires offload (tier1), 16-20GB = tier6a constrained w/ offload, 20-24GB tier6b. Colab free-tier T4 has 15GB usable VRAM (16GB marketed minus 1GB ECC): turbo config fits comfortably; XL turbo fits with offload. A public Kaggle notebook runs AceStep 1.5 XL Turbo 4B on T4 successfully. Third-party summary claims sub-10s full-song synthesis under 4GB VRAM for v1.5.
